title: 8 Slade Castle Wood, Saggart, Co. Dublin
seoTitle: 8 Slade Castle Wood, Saggart, Co. Dublin
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are delighted to present No. 8 Slade Castle Wood, a stunning three-bedroom mid-terrace family home ideally positioned within the highly sought-after “Slade Castle” development in the heart of Saggart Village. No. 8 enjoys an enviable position within this ever-popular development, which continues to attract strong interest due to its convenient location and excellent range of surrounding amenities. The area is well serviced by numerous bus routes, while the Red Line Luas is just a five-minute walk away, providing easy access to Dublin City Centre and beyond. A fine selection of schools can be found close by, with a crèche right on your doorstep. An abundance of local shops, cafés, eateries and recreational facilities are also within easy reach, while the nearby Rathcoole Park provides fantastic outdoor space for families and leisure activities.

 

Bright, airy and exceptionally stylish, this beautifully presented family home offers approximately 112 sq. m. of spacious living accommodation arranged over three floors. Lovingly maintained and extensively upgraded by its current owners, No. 8 comes to the market in true turnkey condition, with no expense spared in creating a comfortable, modern and energy-efficient home. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, guest WC and a superb open-plan living/dining area, complemented by a beautiful fully fitted kitchen with newly tiled finishes. The bright and spacious layout is ideal for both everyday family living and entertaining. On the first floor are two generous double bedrooms, one of which benefits from its own ensuite, together with a stylish main family bathroom featuring newly tiled finishes and new shower units. The top floor is dedicated to the impressive primary bedroom suite, complete with ensuite, a separate walk-in wardrobe and breathtaking views towards the Dublin Mountains. This private top-floor retreat is a particularly special feature of the home. All bedrooms are finished to an excellent standard and feature high-quality fitted wardrobes, plush carpeting and electric blinds that can be operated by remote control or app.

 

The owners have thoughtfully renovated and upgraded the property from top to bottom in recent years. Notable improvements and additional features include a B BER energy rating, offering potential eligibility for a Green Mortgage, new windows, an alarm security system, a new energy-efficient boiler, a Palladio composite front door, new appliances, quality fixtures and fittings, and extensive additional storage, including built-in storage within the attic eaves and under the stairs. Externally, the rear of the property boasts a fully enclosed, private and low-maintenance garden, providing an ideal space for relaxing or entertaining. To the front, the property enjoys a pleasant outlook over a green area together with designated parking.

 

No. 8 is ideally positioned within one of Saggart’s most sought-after developments and represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a spacious, beautifully finished and energy-efficient family home in walk-in condition.
Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the size, comfort, quality and style this exceptional property has to offer. Contact Ray Cooke Auctioneers today for further information or to arrange a viewing!!

 

Features;
- c.112 sq.m
- 3 Bed/ 4 Bath Mid-Terrace
- B Energy Rating/ Green Mortgage Potential
-Pristine condition
-Sought-after development
- MGMT fee c €800 per annum
-Upgraded extensively
- New energy-efficient boiler
-New windows & doors
-Electric blinds system
-Scenic views of the Dublin Mountains
-Designated parking
-No onward chain
-Ideal for first time buyers, growing families & investors
- Crèche on your doorstep
-The perfect turnkey family home
-Early viewing strongly advised!

 

Directions: Coming off the N7 at the Rathcoole/Saggart junction, take the first exit onto Mill road towards Saggart. Take the first exit at the next roundabout you reach and proceed towards village. At the cross roads continue straight ahead for 100m and turn right onto Slade Castle Avenue, follow the road along and take your first left turn onto Slade Castle Wood where number 8 will be on the right.
